caption: The drawing depicts a central oval frame, bordered with alternating red, blue, and white stripes. Inside the oval is a figure riding a horse. The figure wears a brown hat, a red jacket with yellow cuffs, and yellow pants, holding a red flagpole in the left hand and a blue object in the right hand. The horse is brown and white. The ground beneath the horse is yellow with circular shapes and green plants. Above and around the figure inside the oval, a draped curtain with pink and white stripes is decorated with small green rectangles. Along the border of the oval, the phrase "SANTA TERRA MARIA" is written. The outer rectangular background of the drawing contains green and blue ribbon-like leaves and branches with small red flowers, along with two yellow and red feather or leaf shapes at the top and bottom. The rectangular border is blue, and the whole image appears to be richly outlined and filled with linear patterns and a consistent color palette featuring red, green, blue, yellow, brown, and shades of white.
title: Plate 45: Embroidered Bedspread (St. James): From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
